response.rationale: The model failed to prioritize the most up-to-date information. Document d2 (May 2026) is newer than d1 (February 2026), yet the model treated them as a consensus indicating no change, rather than using the latest source to confirm or update the status. It also expressed unnecessary uncertainty ('unclear if there is a new Prime Minister') despite having a very recent source (d2) that should be treated as the primary authority for the current date.
